However, the users often need help to understand the function of the features or commands available in it. Consequently, the users require a longer time to access information and provide feedback. Therefore, this study was conducted to evaluate and determine the level of usability of the system and give some recommendations for improvement. The result of the questionnaire from users reflects user satisfaction. The level of usability was determined based on the respondents’ answers. A case study was conducted on the website siakad.trunojoyo.ac.id. According to the findings of this study, ten attributes have a moderate level of usability, whereas the other fourteen attributes have an excellent level. The testing on each attribute has the highest and lowest values. For example, the attribute with the lowest value is the user interface (UI) design on the web (0.508), and the system which does not contain too much advertising is the highest value (0.737). All in all, the highest level of usability is the website does not have too many advertisements. On the other hand, the lowest level is the attribute of the user interface (UI) design. Finally, the primary issue is content updates are frequently delayed.

articleTitle: Water Requirement Prediction System using Multi-Factors High Order Fuzzy Time Series Method
abstract: Madura Island is a dry area. Madura Island has a deficient average rainfall of 10.5 mm per year. Bangkalan is one of the areas on the island of Madura with a high population density compared to other Madura areas. This causes a shortage of water for daily consumption. Thus, forecasting is needed to predict the water requirement in Bangkalan for clean water service companies. The method used is Multi-Factors High Order Fuzzy Time Series (MFHO FTS), where this method is the Fuzzy Times Series (FTS) method which employs more than one factor that affects forecasting. This study’s contribution is the water requirement prediction system using MFHO FTS Method. There are several steps in the Multi-Factors High Order Fuzzy Time Series method, including forming a Universe of Discourse, determining the number of clusters, forming subintervals, forming fuzzy sets, the fuzzification processes, forming Fuzzy Logic Relationships (FLR), and the defuzzification processes. The measurement with the MAPE calculation obtained from this study is 0.09. The MAPE value close to zero indicates that the Multi-Factors High Order Fuzzy Time Series method can make predictions well.

articleTitle: Face Recognition to Determine Visitor Attraction Using Residual Deep Neural Network
abstract: The development of social media in the form of websites and android applications should be appreciated. The background of this research is the stage to develop the software needed to know the age range. The objective thing to observe is through the visitor’s face on the web or application. The purpose is to avoid false information and get the proper process flow. The Technology used is deep learning for facial image recognition. The methods use Convolutional Neural Network with residuals because the advantage is using multi-branch layers but having a stable training process. The use of augmentation is needed to increase the variety of facial recognition image positions and to overcome unbalanced classes. The dataset used consists of seven categories, namely Children, Youth, Early Workers, Middle Ages, Pre-Retirement, Retirement, and Old People, which Bappenas regulate. Each folder contains about 1157 images with a total data of 8,105 images. The training process results can obtain a model with an average accuracy of 99.08% and a computational training time of about three hundred minutes. The model’s accuracy is 99.08%, with MSE 0.0037, RMSE 0.0610, and MAE 0.0037. Testing time is about 2 seconds.

articleTitle: Analysis of Consumer Satisfaction Levels with GoRide Services Using the Support Vector Machine (SVM) Classification Method
abstract: The online transportation service that is popular and often used by the public is Gojek. Every customer has different feedback on Gojek’s services. The quality of services provided can influence the level of customer satisfaction. Therefore, it is necessary to analyze the prediction of the level of satisfaction of GoRide. This study uses the Support Vector Machine (SVM) method to predict it. The object was the students of IST AKPRIND Yogyakarta. The results of the classification of the level of consumer satisfaction on GoRide use the SVM method, which uses a linear kernel function with Cost = 0.1 and testing data of 25%, producing an accuracy rate of 100%. SVM with RBF kernel function, with a value of Cost = 100 and gamma = 0.00026, makes an accuracy rate of 88.46%. The classification results are that 76.69% of respondents stated that they were satisfied and delighted with the GoRide service. Meanwhile, a total of 23.30% of respondents indicated that they were dissatisfied and very dissatisfied with GoRide’s services. This proves that the SVM method can predict the classification of the level of consumer satisfaction with GoRide services very well.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Government Policy Management on the Handling of Covid-19 Using Naive Bayes with Feature Selection
abstract: The government’s policy in dealing with the Covid-19 pandemic that has entered Indonesia has generated a response from the public, including Twitter social media users. Responses or comments from the community are also very religious, ranging from positive responses in supporting government policies in dealing with this Covid-19 to negative reactions in the form of criticism of the government, which is considered to have underestimated this virus. We use sentiment analysis to determine whether an opinion or comment containing a statement is positive or negative. The comments are rated by Indonesian language experts. In this study, the sentiment analysis process uses the TF-IDF method for word weighting, the information gain method for feature selection, and the Naive Bayes method for classifying public opinion. The results of this study indicate that the Naive Bayes algorithm is quite good in the text data classification model, with the highest accuracy, precision, and recall levels of 87.0%, 89.0%, and 98.0%, respectively. The average accuracy, precision, and recall levels are 86.2%, 87.6%, and 97%, respectively. This research can provide accurate and valuable information for the community regarding the response of Twitter users to the policy of handling Covid-19 in Indonesia.

articleTitle: Development of Extraction-based Text Summarization Application to Improve Children’s Literacy in Storybook Reading
abstract: The literacy level in Indonesia is relatively low. The reading literacy ranking evidences this at 72 out of 77. Even though reading literacy is very important for the country’s and children’s future, improving literacy can be started by adopting the habit of reading from an early age or once as a child. One way to increase children’s interest in reading is through short stories. However, children’s reading literacy with an understanding of the summary or essence of this short story needs to be analyzed further. This requires an application that can summarize the short story automatically to get a representative short story subject. Therefore, the research proposed extraction-based text summarization to summarize children’s stories using the TF-IDF (Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency) algorithm. The application has been tested on five children’s stories, compared to another text summarization application, and gets a similarity of summary to reach 80%. The experiment result reported that the summarization has a well-structured storyline, the story’s meaning is still conveyed, and efficient in time. By summarizing children’s stories, a story looks shorter and increases children’s interest in reading which leads to adopting reading habits.
